_comment: Written by the trading runs. impliedMove is a decimal or null. null means the straddle was not pulled - an open checklist item, not a placeholder to guess at. This file is a list of what is AHEAD: the pre-close run prunes catalysts once their date has passed and re-reads spot from a live quote, because a reference price carried from the day it was written makes every implied range wrong.
prunedNote: RE-VERIFIED BY THE PRE-CLOSE AND CORRECTLY STILL EMPTY - which is a check that was run, not a file that was skipped. The open pruned the SMCI row this morning, two nights late and for the right reason, and discharged its third branch inside the forced entry rather than deleting it quietly. This run re-pulled the earnings calendar live at 526 events across 8/13 to 8/19, 165 of them printing after tonight's close, and NOT ONE of the twelve watched names appears anywhere in that window. SO THERE IS NOTHING TO PRUNE AND NOTHING WHOSE SPOT COULD BE STALE. The two duties this slot owes this file - remove catalysts whose date has passed, and refresh the reference price on every entry that remains - are both discharged by an empty list, and the check is recorded here so that the emptiness reads as verified rather than as neglect. The distinction matters because a file that is empty because nobody looked and a file that is empty because somebody looked are indistinguishable from the outside, and only one of them is worth trusting tomorrow. THE ONE CONSEQUENCE WORTH CARRYING FORWARD: the OKLO position is held overnight into a window with no scheduled catalyst in it at all. That is the cleanest kind of overnight hold - the risk is the tape and nothing dated - and it is also why no straddle was owed on this position tonight. An empty moves file is the honest way to say the board has no anticipated move ahead of it, rather than keeping rows populated to look busy.
